#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int inputNumber;
    cin >> inputNumber;
    int total = inputNumber * 2;
    const int MOD = 1000000007;

    // Initialize 3D vector with zeros
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> table(total + 1, vector<vector<int>>(total + 1, vector<int>(2, 0)));

    for (int i = 1; i <= total; i++) {
        for (int h = 0; h <= i; h++) {
            if ((i - h) % 2 != 0) continue;
            if (h + 1 <= i - 1) {
                table[i][h][0] = (table[i - 1][h + 1][1] + 1) % MOD;
                table[i][h][1] = table[i - 1][h + 1][0];
                if (h > 0) {
                    table[i][h][0] = (table[i][h][0] + table[i - 1][h - 1][0]) % MOD;
                    table[i][h][1] = (table[i][h][1] + table[i - 1][h - 1][0]) % MOD;
                }
            } else {
                table[i][h][0] = (table[i - 1][h - 1][1] + 1) % MOD;
                table[i][h][1] = table[i - 1][h - 1][0];
            }
        }
    }
    cout << table[total][0][0] << "\n";
    return 0;
}
